note: Case manifest for tests/proof-harness/capture.mjs. Every seed entry names its kind explicitly: 'engine_seed' = state this driver launches live through the plugin door (zero-token graphs; one real assistant turn for the card echo); 'historical_snapshot' = a pinned, already-committed run/session fixture read via the door's legacy-launch-root fallback (read-only, never relaunched). Adding a case ADDS A NEW TEST: a case naming a surface outside surfaces_registry fails exit 3 ('new test, not implemented') — the driver never fabricates an existing command. Baseline never captures synthesis/index.html or any file-openable RC: surfaces come from the real app renderer only.

baseline.description: Real-app proof of the three live surfaces of the actual React/SDK renderer: the ::workflow directive card in the message stream, the WORKFLOWS pane (run list + held-gate run detail), and the settings-gated live-run tray row. All state is engine-seeded into an isolated test runs root; nothing here is a CHATFRAME reconstruction.

seeds.name: held_gate_run
seeds.note: echo+gate+echo graph — full gate UI (held pill, answer receipt) at zero tokens; the proven lookbook shape (run 20261122-113636-lookbook-canvas-held). The tray_row seed relaunches THIS SAME graph with WF_OWNER_SESSION=<one-shot session id>: the composer strip renders only the focused chat's owned runs (ownedRuns law, plugin.js:728), so a blank-owner run is pane-only. Both runs are stopped through the door at teardown.

seeds.name: directive_card_echo
seeds.note: Cards render ONLY from assistant-role text (SKILL hermes-workflows-ui-qa): one `hermes chat --oneshot -Q` turn whose answer is the directive verbatim. model/provider null rides the seat default (documented in SETUP.md).

gate.description: bd_2026-11-13-qri real-app proof of the ONE decision surface: held gate cell (verbatim question, declared requester, options) -> trusted click -> REAL pending frame (the answer POST held at CDP Fetch interception) -> durable Answer-saved receipt -> success toast with View exact gate -> route-away/route-back identity proof -> gates/<id>.json read-back (_ui:true, exact answer, events ledger byte-identical: nothing restarted for this tested isolated runner).

seeds.name: held_gate_run
seeds.note: gate-only zero-token seed; the runner is SIGKILLed at gate.held so the UI answer lands on a dead-runner (interrupted) run and can be proven record-only — the exact RC sandbox shape (runner_live=false), never a re-answer of a historical seed.
